verdict.line: You lose extended trades before level 6 or once Irelia banks 5 passive stacks, and you win by poking to 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste and turning the Q stun into a Devour.

brief.thesis: Irelia's Q (Bladesurge) dash-reset and stacking Ionian Fervor passive make her the better all-in champion in short, early trades, which is why OP.GG shows her with the lane and solo-kill edge. Tahm Kench answers with a longer game plan: Q (Tongue Lash) pokes from range 900, heals him, and stacks An Acquired Taste toward a stun, which becomes a free Devour once R unlocks at level 6. The 51.9% win rate over 156 games says that plan works more often than the raw lane stats suggest - this is an even-to-favored matchup for you if you play the stack game instead of trading auto for auto.

theirWindow.what: Ionian Fervor at max stacks gives her bonus attack speed and on-hit damage - this is exactly the window OP.GG warns you off. Back off, reset with E's stored shield, and let the stacks fall off before you re-engage.

yourWindow.when: after you land 3 stacks of Q
yourWindow.what: Your third landed Q stuns and consumes the stacks instead of just slowing. Walk up and Devour (R) immediately after - it has no independent cooldown once the stacks are there, so this is a free burst or peel window.

powerCurve.note: Bladesurge dash-heal wins short early trades
Flawless Duet stun punishes extended all-ins
R lets you Devour stacked, stunned Irelia

start.why: Takes 52.7% of 129 games and is the clear majority pick (66.8%) - the extra sustain against Irelia's auto-reset poke matters more than Doran's Helm's magic pen, which you don't need as much against a physical-damage dasher.

boots.why: 81.5% pick rate at 50.7% win rate - Irelia's damage comes from on-hit autos stacked by her passive, and flat physical damage reduction directly cuts that down more than tenacity would.

core.why: Builds the total health your passive (An Acquired Taste) scales off of, turning your autos into real damage while giving you the HP buffer to tank Irelia's stacked-passive burst windows.
Standard second item in the most common core path, keeping your stat growth on track into the mid-game skirmish phase.
Directly punishes an auto-attack, on-hit-reliant champion like Irelia - the reflect damage and grievous wounds both land hardest the moment her passive stacks are up.

situational.when: irelia is rushing a lifesteal or on-hit item and her Q sustain is getting out of hand early
you need more raw healing to out-sustain her poke through back-to-back waves
you want the extra shield-on-ability-use layered on top of Thick Skin against her burst windows
the game is going long and you need more magic damage scaling instead of a second armor item

runes.keystoneWhy: Appears in both common rune pages (51.5% and 40% pick share) - the proc rewards exactly the poke-and-walk-away pattern your maxed Q enables, and the permanent health growth feeds your passive's damage scaling.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the most-picked combo (52.6% pick, 48.5% win rate) and gives you the kill pressure to close out a stun-into-Devour window before Irelia can trade back. Flash+Teleport (21.9% pick) is the alternative if you expect a longer, wave-management-focused lane instead of early skirmishes.

playing.title: Poke with maxed Q first
playing.detail: Your skill order maxes Q (Tongue Lash) first, so lead every interaction with it at range 900 to slow, heal yourself, and stack An Acquired Taste rather than trading autos.

playing.title: Track her passive stack count
playing.detail: Ionian Fervor stacks on every spell-hit; disengage once she's near 5 stacks per OP.GG's own read on this matchup, since her bonus attack speed and on-hit damage swing extended fights hard in her favor.

playing.title: Punish Bladesurge resets on minions
playing.detail: Her Q (Bladesurge) refreshes its cooldown if it kills or hits a Marked target. When she dashes into a minion to reset it, that's your free window to walk up and land a Q of your own.

playing.title: Save Devour for 3 stacks
playing.detail: R (Devour) carries no independent cooldown - the moment Irelia has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste consumed by your Q's stun, Devour her instantly for magic damage or to pull her off a teammate.

playing.title: Time E to already-banked damage
playing.detail: Thick Skin's passive only stores damage you've already taken while out of combat; pop the active mid-trade rather than pre-emptively so the shield you get back is as large as possible.

playing.title: Respect the Flawless Duet pincer
playing.detail: Her E (Flawless Duet) fires two blades that converge from range 850 - standing between them and a wall or minion wave gets you stunned and Marked, which sets up her follow-up damage.

playing.title: Use W to engage or bail
playing.detail: Abyssal Dive (cooldown 21 down to 17s at max rank) dives and knocks up everyone in the landing area - use it to reset a losing trade or to close distance and combo into a Q stun once stacks are ready.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and win-rate numbers above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning, trade patterns, and timing calls are my own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid fighting Irelia when she has 5 (P) stacks. Otherwise, you will win the fight. Pull lane while farming and retreat only when she has 5 stacks prepared.
